evals.prompt: Schedule this on my LinkedIn for next Tuesday at 9am: "Most retros die at the action step. 1-3 owned actions, or it didn't happen."
evals.expected_output: Preflights BROWSERLESS_URL/TOKEN and li_at freshness. Writes the post text to a file. Runs scripts/post_linkedin.py with --at (next Tuesday 09:00, local tz) as a DRY RUN first, reads the schedule_filled/schedule_review screenshots to confirm text and time, then asks the user to confirm before re-running with --confirm. Reports the scheduled local time. Never runs --confirm unprompted.
expectations: BROWSERLESS_URL and BROWSERLESS_TOKEN presence and li_at cookie freshness are checked before any browser action
The post text is written to a file and scripts/post_linkedin.py runs with --at for next Tuesday 09:00 local time as a dry run first
The schedule screenshots are read to confirm text and time before confirming
Nothing is scheduled before the user confirms the preview

evals.prompt: post this to linkedin right now: We just open-sourced our retrospective skill. Link in comments.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an immediate post (no schedule time). Notes that in-body links suppress reach and offers/handles the first-comment strategy. Dry-runs first (composed.jpg), gets confirmation, then --confirm. Verifies via the returned stage=posted, does not claim success on any other stage.
expectations: The reply notes that in-body links suppress reach and offers the first-comment approach
A dry run produces a composed preview before any publish
The publish runs only after explicit confirmation and with --confirm
Success is claimed only from the returned stage=posted result

evals.prompt: put a post on linkedin for me
evals.expected_output: During preflight, checks li_at expiry. If the cookie file is missing/expired, stops and explains the session must be re-exported from a browser — does NOT attempt a password login and does NOT fabricate a success. If session is live, proceeds to compose + dry-run. (Also acceptable: asks what the post should say before doing anything.)
expectations: Preflight checks li_at expiry before composing
If the cookie is missing or expired the flow stops and explains the session must be re-exported from a browser
No password login is attempted and no success is fabricated

evals.prompt: schedule a tweet for tomorrow morning
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is X/Twitter, not LinkedIn, and does not run the linkedin-post flow. Says this skill is LinkedIn-only (even though x.json cookies exist in the same folder), rather than posting to the wrong network.
expectations: The reply states this skill is LinkedIn-only and does not run the linkedin-post flow
No post is made to X/Twitter even though x.json cookies exist
The user is pointed to the right tool for X

evals.prompt: put this on linkedin for monday 9am. text is in ~/drafts/hiring-update.md, we just closed our seed round and i want the announcement live before the team standup
evals.expected_output: Skill runs a dry-run for a LinkedIn schedule at next Monday 09:00, shows preview screenshots and the exact text, and waits for explicit confirmation before re-running with --confirm.
expectations: Preflight checks that the local Chrome profile env vars ($LINKEDIN_LOCAL_CHROME, $LINKEDIN_CHROME_PROFILE) or browserless env vars are set, reading them from env and not hardcoding them
The post text from ~/drafts/hiring-update.md is placed in a file and used verbatim
post_linkedin.py is run without --confirm first, with --at set to the Monday 09:00 time the user asked for
The screenshots (composed.jpg, schedule_review.jpg) are read and the 'Posting at' line is compared with the requested date and time
Nothing is published or scheduled with --confirm until the user explicitly approves the preview
No password is requested or typed

evals.prompt: publish the launch announcement in ~/drafts/launch.md to my profile. attach ~/assets/launch-hero.png as the image. show me what it will look like first
evals.expected_output: Skill dry-runs a post-now with the launch image attached via --media, shows the preview, and does not publish until the user confirms.
expectations: A dry-run preview of the exact post text and the attached image is shown before anything is published
The image is passed with --media ~/assets/launch-hero.png and no --document flag is used in the same run
If the draft has a link in the first line, the skill moves it to the first comment and tells the user
The final run with --confirm happens only after an explicit user go-ahead
The report states the returned stage (posted or failed) and does not claim success on any other stage

evals.prompt: share our whitepaper ~/docs/state-of-ai-2026.pdf as a swipeable document post on linkedin with the caption 'State of AI 2026'. text in ~/drafts/whitepaper-post.txt
evals.expected_output: Skill posts a PDF as a LinkedIn document post using --document with the given title, dry-run first, rejecting nothing valid and not mixing media.
expectations: The PDF is passed with --document and --document-title 'State of AI 2026'
The skill does not combine --document with --media
A dry-run preview is produced and shown before any --confirm run
Nothing is published without explicit confirmation from the user
Cookies and profile paths are not printed in the output, and no password is requested
